Load Libraries
```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)
library(signal)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(miceadds)
library(snakecase)
source.all("/Users/nicoletorrie/Documents/Dalhousie/MSc/r/algalrithms/R")
```

## set parameters ----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# which file do you want to process? 
select_sampling_date <- "2026-09-14"
select_station <- "Aquahub Mooring"


# Set your parameters
null_point_wavelength_nm = 685
min_nm <- 200
max_nm <- 800
smoothing_window = 15
method = "savitsky_golay"

# set your project path
project_path <- "/Users/nicoletorrie/Documents/Dalhousie/MSc/primary_productivity_project/antigonish_sampling"

# Set the path to your CDOM metadata file
cdom_metadata <- read_excel("/Users/nicoletorrie/Documents/Dalhousie/MSc/primary_productivity_project/antigonish_sampling/antigonish_cdom_metadata.xlsx")%>%
  mutate(across(contains("sampling_date"), as.character))
```



## read in data ----------------------------------------------------------------
You do not need to alter any variables here
```{r}
station_metadata <- cdom_metadata %>% 
  dplyr::filter(sampling_date == select_sampling_date & station == select_station)

short_date <- station_metadata$short_date
blank_name <- station_metadata$blank_name
sample_name <- station_metadata$sample_name
path_length <- station_metadata$path_length_m

path <-
  file.path(paste0(
      project_path, "/" ,
      short_date, "/", "cary_cdom"))

raw_cdom_path <- list.dirs(path, recursive = TRUE) %>% grep(pattern = "cdom_raw", value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

```


Select and clean blank and sample data, bind them together
```{r}

## Blank data
blank_df <- read_csv(paste0(raw_cdom_path, "/", blank_name), col_names = TRUE)

# set column names based on first row
names(blank_df) <- as.character(blank_df[1,]) 

blank_df1 <- blank_df %>% janitor::clean_names()

# now remove the first row (header), remove the blank last column, convert absorption to numeric, and make a new column averaging the reps
blank_df2 <- blank_df1[-c(1), -c(7), drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(across(contains("Abs"), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(avg_blank_abs = rowMeans(pick(contains("Abs")), na.rm = TRUE))

# make a new dataframe with the averaged blank values
blank_df_clean <- blank_df2[, c(1,7)] 



## Sample data
sample_df <- read_csv(paste0(raw_cdom_path, "/", sample_name), col_names = TRUE)

# set column names based on first row
names(sample_df) <- as.character(sample_df[1,]) 

sample_df1 <- sample_df %>% janitor::clean_names()

# now remove the first row (header), remove the blank last column, convert absorption to numeric, and make a new column averaging the reps
sample_df2 <- sample_df1[-c(1), -c(7), drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(across(contains("Abs"), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(avg_sample_abs = rowMeans(pick(contains("Abs")), na.rm = TRUE))

# make a new dataframe with the averaged blank values
sample_df_clean <- sample_df2[, c(1,7)]




# bind together blank and sample into one dataframe, and filter rows above or below set wavelength range
cbind_data_df <- cbind(blank_df_clean, select(sample_df_clean, -"wavelength_nm")) %>%
  mutate(across(contains("wavelength"), as.numeric)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(`wavelength_nm` >= min_nm &
                  `wavelength_nm` <= max_nm)



# plot raw data
ggplot(cbind_data_df, aes(x = wavelength_nm)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, aes(y = avg_blank_abs, color = "Blank")) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, aes(y = avg_sample_abs, color = "Sample")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Blank" = "black", "Sample" = "blue")) +
  labs(color = "Legend", y = "Absorption", x = "Wavelength (nm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle(paste0(select_sampling_date, " ", select_station, " Raw"))

```


## process CDOM data ----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# clean and smooth the absorption data, based on your desired method and inputs (set above)
processed_cdom <- al_process_cdom_absorption_scan(
  data = cbind_data_df,
  null_point_wavelength = null_point_wavelength_nm,
  path_length_m = path_length,
  smoothing_window_nm = smoothing_window,
  method = method
)

```



```{r}
# plot the absorption scan
if (method == "savitsky_golay") {
 title_method <- "Savitsky Golay Smoothed"
} else if (method == "linear") {
  title_method <- "Linear Smoothed"}


ggplot(processed_cdom, aes(x = wavelength_nm)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75, aes(y = corrected_absorption, color = "No Smoothing")) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5,
            aes(y = corrected_absorption_smoothed, color = "Smoothed")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("No Smoothing" = "red", "Smoothed" = "blue")) +
  labs(color = "Legend", y = "Absorption", x = "Wavelength (nm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle(paste0(select_sampling_date, " ", select_station, " CDOM, ", title_method))
  
```
## Print processed CDOM file with metadata ----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
write_cdom_path <- list.dirs(path, recursive = TRUE) %>% grep(pattern = "cdom_processed", value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
snake_station_name <- to_snake_case(select_station)
unique_id <- format(now(), format = "%y%m%d_%H%M")

fwrite(processed_cdom, 
       paste0(write_cdom_path, "/", 
              paste0(select_sampling_date,"_", snake_station_name, "_processed_cdom_", unique_id, ".csv")))
```
